objectives.title: Find details in a short text

lessons.explanation: Present acabar de + infinitive expresses something just completed. Conjugate acabar for the subject, keep de, and leave the action as an infinitive. This differs from acabar alone, to finish.
commonMistakes: Do not use a preterite after de: acabo de comprar, not acabo de compré.
lessons.provenance: Original Palabra lesson; grammatical rules checked against RAE references. Author review, 2026-10-30; no independent teacher audit.

lessons.explanation: With gustar, encantar and interesar, match the verb to the thing that causes the reaction. Use me/te/le/nos/les for the person reacting. A mí or a Ana adds emphasis or clarifies the person; the pronoun remains.
examples: A Ana le interesan los documentales.
commonMistakes: A Ana gustan is missing le. Match interesan to plural documentales, not to Ana.
lessons.provenance: Original Palabra lesson; grammatical rules checked against RAE references. Author review, 2026-10-30; no independent teacher audit.

lessons.explanation: Read the question first. Find the sentence that gives that detail, and check who, when or where it describes.
examples: ¿Cuándo? Look for the time or day.
commonMistakes: A familiar word alone may not answer the question. Check the whole message.

stimuli.SpanishText: Acabamos de ver una película en casa. A mí me gustan las comedias, pero a Ana le interesan más los documentales. Mi hermano acaba de preparar comida. Nos encanta comer juntos y hablar del programa. A mis padres les gusta esta película porque es divertida. Yo acabo de escribir un mensaje a Luis. Él quiere venir mañana. Vamos a ver un documental sobre animales porque a todos nos interesan los animales.
stimuli.provenance: Original fictional passage, authored for Palabra. Not a textbook reading.
